name: Montana Domino Rummy
description: Montana Domino Rummy is a western domino rummy-style game typically played with multiple double-six sets to provide sufficient tile supply. This entry models the shared tile family and supply using four double-six sets; the rummy-style sequencing and layout objectives are expressed as a table profile layered on top of the tile set.

content.text: Montana Domino Rummy is a western domino rummy-style game typically played with multiple double-six sets to provide sufficient tile supply. This entry models the shared tile family and supply using four double-six sets; the rummy-style sequencing and layout objectives are expressed as a table profile layered on top of the tile set.
Montana-style domino rummy formats are encountered as modern table games that use dominoes in structured layouts resembling rummy sequencing goals.
Four double-6 domino sets combined and mixed.
Domino sets and an agreed layout/scoring profile.
Tiles are distributed according to the chosen layout profile; any remaining tiles may be held aside or used as a draw pool by table rules.
